snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - Road Trip: Ford DLC Video Trailer
snippet.description:
We are very excited to reveal the official video trailer and release date for the Road Trip: Ford DLC coming to American Truck Simulator!

Add the DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793200/American_Truck_Simulator__Road_Trip_Ford/
